title: A Modern and Flexible Data Pipeline for SurveyCTO
text: ctoclient modern, fast, flexible high-level R client SurveyCTO REST API. Built top robust httr2 framework, provides consistent pipe-friendly interface programmatic access server resources.

title: A Modern and Flexible Data Pipeline for SurveyCTO
text: Analysis Ready: Automatically tidies messy API responses clean data frames. Encrypted Data Support: Seamlessly handle encrypted forms private keys. Media fields: Strips URLs image, audio, video fields, leaving filename. Geopoints: Splits geopoint variables four columns _lat, _long, _alt, _acc suffixes. original column kept name. Select multiple: Adds binary columns export omits respondent picked option, fills unselected options 0 rows selected least one. row selected nothing keeps NA, "asked answered none" stays distinct "never asked". step applied independently: one fails, message naming step printed remaining steps still run, partial failure returns data rather error.

title: Retrieve Server Metadata and Resource Lists — cto_metadata
text: String. Specifies subset metadata return cto_metadata(). One : "" (default): Returns list containing groups, datasets, forms. "groups": Returns data frame form groups. "datasets": Returns data frame server datasets. "forms": Returns data frame deployed forms. order_by String. Field sort results . Available fields vary function (e.g., "createdOn", "id", "title", "username"). sort String. Sort direction: "ASC" (ascending) "DESC" (descending). parent_group_id Number (Optional). Filter groups parent group ID. role_id String (Optional). Filter users specific Role ID.
